dashboard.title: Guudmarka jaamacadda
dashboard.needsAction: Waxay u baahan tahay dib u eegis
dashboard.subtitle: Kani waa guudmarka tababarrada iyo meelaynta.
dashboard.placementOverviewHint: Dhammaan meelaynta jaamacaddaadu leedahay, marxaladahooda oo dhan.
dashboard.verificationProgressHint: Intee ka mid ah ardaydaada ayaa haysta diiwaangelin la xaqiijiyay.
dashboard.verifiedOf: {{verified}} ka mid ah {{total}} ayaa la xaqiijiyay
dashboard.noNominationsHint: Magacaabistu halkan way ka soo muuqanayaan marka iskuduwuhu arday u soo jeediyo tababar loo talagalay.
dashboard.noPartnersHint: Hay’ad halkan way ka soo muuqanaysaa marka ay martigeliso ardaydaada mid ka mid ah.

setup.title: Diiwaangeli jaamacaddaada
setup.body: Diiwaan geli jaamacaddaada si aad u bilowdo maamulka xaqiijinta ardayda iyo meel dhigidda tababarka. Waxaad casumi kartaa asxaabtaada marka la abuuro.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi foomka oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Hadda lama diiwaan gelin karin jaamacaddaada. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.

setup.registrationNumberHint: Lambarka rasmiga ah ee diiwaangelinta ama aqoonsiga ee ku qoran dukumeentiga diiwaangelinta jaamacaddaada. Weligii laguma muujiyo profile-kaaga dadweynaha.

profile.title: Astaanta jaamacadda

logo.hint: JPEG ama PNG, ilaa 3MB. Waxaa si guud loogu muujiyaa astaantaada.
logo.label: Astaanta

profile.submitForVerificationBody: Jaamacaddaadu waa in la xaqiijiyaa ka hor inta ay fursado tababar ku bareeri karaan.

evidence.label: Shatiga diiwaangelinta ama aqoonsiga
evidence.hint: PDF oo keliya, ilaa 10 MB. Soo gelinta fayl cusub waxay beddeshaa kan hadda kaydsan.
evidence.attached: Dukumeenti shati ah ayaa la diiwaangeliyay.
evidence.required: Ku lifaaq dukumeentigaaga shatiga ka hor inta aadan u gudbin xaqiijinta.
evidence.privacy: Waa sir — kaliya shaqaalaha jaamacaddaada iyo kooxda xaqiijinta FursadHub ayaa furi kara.

errors.UNIVERSITY_VERIFICATION_INVALID_TRANSITI: Jaamacaddan lagama gudbin karo xaqiijinta xaaladdeeda hadda.
errors.UNIVERSITY_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRE: Ku lifaaq dukumeentigaaga shatiga ka hor inta aadan u gudbin xaqiijinta.
errors.UNIVERSITY_EVIDENCE_FILE_INVALID: Faylkaasi lama aqbalo — soo geli PDF ka yar 10MB.
errors.UNIVERSITY_LOGO_FILE_INVALID: Faylkaasi lama aqbalo — soo geli JPEG ama PNG ka yar 3MB.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Faylku wuu ka weyn yahay xadka ugu badan ee la ogol yahay.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi foomka oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Taasi ma dhammaystirmin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale — boggani wuxuu muujinayaa waxa hadda kaydsan.
errors.invalidUrl: Geli cinwaan buuxa oo ku bilaabma http:// ama https://
errors.invalidCountry: Isticmaal laba xaraf oo dal ah.

profile.subtitle: Diiwaanka machadkaaga iyo xaaladdiisa xaqiijinta ee FursadHub.
profile.detailsHint: Faahfaahintan waxay ka muuqataa profile-ka jaamacadda ee dadweynaha.
profile.publicContactEmailHint: Cinwaan machadeed oo la wadaago sida careers@ — marnaba ma aha cinwaanka gelitaanka shaqaale gaar ah.

cover.label: Sawirka daboolka
cover.hint: JPG ama PNG. Waxa uu ka muuqdaa astaanta profile-kaaga dadweynaha.
cover.emptyHint: Weli sawir daboolka ah ma jiro. Mid soo geli si profile-kaagu u helo astaan.
cover.replaceHint: Soo gelinta sawir cusub waxay bedeshaa kan hadda jira.

verificationNext.title: Maxaa xiga
verificationNext.attach: Ku lifaaq dukumeentigaaga, kadibna dooro "U gudbi xaqiijinta".
verificationNext.review: Kooxda xaqiijinta FursadHub ayaa dib u eegaysa dukumeentigaaga iyo faahfaahinta jaamacaddaada.
verificationNext.notify: Waa lagu wargelin doonaa marka jaamacaddaada la xaqiijiyo, ama haddii kooxdu codsato isbeddello.

departments.title: Qaybaha

errors.DEPARTMENT_CODE_ALREADY_EXISTS: Qayb koodhkan leh ayaa hore ugu jirta jaamacaddaada.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi foomka oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Wax baa qaldamay. Fadlan isku day mar kale.

departments.subtitle: Waaxyaha ay tababarrada iyo doorarka shaqaaluhu ku dhisan yihiin.
departments.emptyHint: Ku dar waaxdaada ugu horreysa si aad u bilowdo qoondaynta.

students.title: Ardayda

statusValues.NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Waxaa loo baahan yahay caddayn dheeraad ah

students.subtitle: Ardayda diiwaangashan iyo xaaladda xaqiijinta diiwaangelintooda.
students.searchPlaceholder: Ku raadi email, lambarka ardayga ama barnaamijka

verificationQueue.title: Safka xaqiijinta
verificationQueue.subtitle: Sheegashooyinka diiwaangelinta ardaydaada, kuwa ugu cusub marka hore. Fur kiis si aad u eegto caddaynta oo aad go’aan u gaadho.

caseDetail.consumeChallengeBody: Weydii ardayga koodhkiisa mar-hal-ah oo halkan ku qor si aad u xaqiijiso aqoonsigiisa.

errors.VERIFICATION_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: Koodhkani wuu dhacay. Weydii ardayga inuu mid cusub sameeyo.
errors.VERIFICATION_CHALLENGE_INVALID: Koodhkani waa khalad ama horeba waa la isticmaalay.
errors.VERIFICATION_CASE_INVALID_TRANSITION: Ficilkan lama heli karo xaaladda hadda ee kiiskan.
errors.generic: Go’aankaas lama diiwaangelin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale — kiisku wuxuu muujinayaa xaaladdiisa hadda.
errors.VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE_MISSING: Kiiskan dukumenti caddayn ah looma hayo.

caseDetail.notesHint: Ardayga wuu arki doonaa, sidaas darteed sheeg waxa uu samayn karo.
caseDetail.evidenceBody: Dukumentiga ardaygu soo geliyay si uu u taageero sheegashadan.
caseDetail.escalateBody: Waa kiis jaamacaddaadu keligeed xallin karin — aqoonsi lagu muransan yahay, ama diiwaan aadan xaqiijin karin. Gelitaankaagu ma beddelmo, kiiskuna wuxuu sii hayaa xaaladdiisa hadda.
caseDetail.escalateConfirm: Sarkaal xaqiijin oo FursadHub ah ayaa awoodi doona inuu eego oo xalliyo kiiskan. Adiguna gelitaankaaga waad sii haysataa.
caseDetail.escalationReasonLabel: Maxaa halkan looga xallin karin kiiskan?
caseDetail.escalationReasonHint: Eegaha nidaamku wuu akhrinayaa, sidaas darteed sii wixii uu ku qaadi karo.

staff.title: Shaqaalaha
staff.passwordLabel: Furaha sirta ah ee ku-meel-gaarka ah
staff.resetPassword: Dib u deji furaha sirta ah
staff.resetPasswordOnceWarning: Furahan sirta ah hal mar ayaa la muujinayaa. Hadda la wadaag shaqaalaha.

errors.STAFF_ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: Akoonkan kama maamuli kartid maaraynta shaqaalaha.
errors.STAFF_SCOPE_REQUIRED: Fadlan dooro ugu yaraan hal qaybood.
errors.STAFF_PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: Furaha sirta ah iyo xaqiijintiisu isku mid ma aha.
errors.USER_CLOSED: Akoon la xiray lama hakin karo ama dib looma firfircoonayn karo.
errors.DEPARTMENT_NOT_IN_UNIVERSITY: Hal ama in ka badan oo qaybo ah kama tirsana jaamacaddan.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi foomka oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Codsigu ma dhammaystirmin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale — liiska shaqaaluhu wuxuu muujinayaa xaaladda hadda ee qof kasta.
errors.USERNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS: Magaca isticmaalahaas horey ayaa loo qaatay.
errors.USERNAME_IMMUTABLE: Akoonkani horey ayuu u leeyahay magac isticmaale, lamana beddeli karo.
errors.STAFF_ADMIN_MEMBERSHIP_PROTECTED: Xisaabaadka maamulaha jaamacadda lagama beddeli karo maaraynta shaqaalaha. Isticmaal goobaha akoonkaaga si aad u beddesho furahaaga sirta ah.

staff.subtitle: Samee oo maamul akoonnada shaqaalaha gudaha jaamacadda.
staff.createHint: Akoonku wuxuu noqonayaa mid firfircoon, wuxuuna ku soo galayaa bogga caadiga ah ee FursadHub. Shaqaaluhu iskood isuma diiwaangeliyaan.
staff.departmentsHint: Ugu yaraan hal waax ayaa loo baahan yahay. Kani waa xadka uu server-ku dhaqan gelinayo.
staff.emptyHint: Weli ma jiraan akoonno shaqaale. Samee mid si aad u wareejiso isku-duwidda ama kormeerka.
staff.noDepartmentsBody: Dooraska shaqaale kastaa waa inuu ku xidhan yahay ugu yaraan hal waax, sidaa darteed marka hore samee waax.
staff.usernameHint: Shaqaaluhu tan ayuu ku soo gelayaa. Xarfo yaryar, tirooyin, dhibco, xariiqyo hoose ama jajab.
staff.displayNameHint: Sida qofkan uga muuqdo FursadHub. Ikhtiyaari.
staff.assignUsernameTitle: U qoondee magac isticmaale oo gelitaan
staff.assignUsernameHint: Tani waa mid joogto ah. Marka la qoondeeyo, akoonku wuxuu ku soo galayaa magaca isticmaalaha, emailkuna wuxuu joojinayaa inuu noqdo aqoonsi.

confirm.suspendBody: Waa laga saarayaa qalab kasta, mana soo geli karaan ilaa aad dib u howlgeliso.
confirm.resetPasswordTitle: Ma dib u dejinaysaa furaha sirta ah ee {{name}}?
confirm.resetPasswordBody: Furaha sirta ah ee hadda jira wuu joogsanayaa, waxaana laga saarayaa meel kasta. Hal mar ayaad arki doontaa furaha sirta ah ee ku meel gaarka ah — si ammaan ah ugu gudbi.
confirm.revokeBody: Isla markiiba waxay waayayaan gelitaanka goobtan shaqada. Tan dib looma celin karo.

feedback.suspendDone: {{name}} waa la hakiyay, waxaana laga saaray meel kasta.
feedback.reactivateDone: {{name}} mar kale ayuu soo geli karaa.
feedback.revokeDone: {{name}} hadda ma laha gelitaanka goobta shaqada jaamacaddan.
feedback.resetPasswordFailed: Dib looma dejin karin furaha sirta ah ee {{name}}.

partners.emptyHint: Ururku halkan ayuu ka muuqanayaa marka mid ka mid ah ardaydaada lagu meeleeyo.

supervision.logsPending_other: {{count}} diiwaan toddobaadle ah oo sugaya dib u eegistaada
